tool_input.command:
grep -q "LV_USE_CHART" firmware/platformio.ini || sed -i '' 's|    -DLV_USE_ANIMIMG=0\n|&|' firmware/platformio.ini; python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='firmware/platformio.ini'
s=open(p).read()
# add LV_USE_CHART to the lcd_43 env only, next to its other LVGL flags
blk=re.search(r'(\[env:waveshare_lcd_43\].*?)(\n\[env:|\Z)', s, re.S)
if blk and 'LV_USE_CHART' not in blk.group(1):
    new=blk.group(1).replace('    -DLV_USE_ANIMIMG=0\n', '    -DLV_USE_ANIMIMG=0\n    -DLV_USE_CHART=1\n')
    s=s[:blk.start(1)]+new+s[blk.end(1):]
    open(p,'w').write(s)
    print('added LV_USE_CHART=1 to waveshare_lcd_43')
else:
    print('already present or env not found')
EOF
tool_input.description: Enable LVGL chart for this env
